headline: Netlink NBN Trust Names Low Ka Hoe as Next Chief Executive Officer
summary: Netlink NBN Trust announced that former ST Engineering and Singtel executive Low Ka Hoe will take over as CEO, serving as CEO-designate starting November 10 before assuming full duties.
why: Netlink NBN Trust owns the nationwide optical fibre network for Singapore's Ultra-Fast Broadband, operating as a core critical telecommunications infrastructure utility.

impacts.name: Netlink NBN Trust
impacts.why: The trust appointed a new CEO-designate to ensure leadership succession.
